additional_concerns: The formula delegates exposure identification, measurement, aggregation and designation applicability to supplied judgments. OMITS findings about those assessments do not alone establish defects in the Boolean classification rule.

The global CONFLICT block can prevent classification even when one independent route is established. This is an additional operational restriction, not a condition stated by the circular. A blocked evaluation must not be interpreted as permission to disregard an established classification basis.

The designation branch has no explicit below-50% guard. This does not change known Boolean outcomes above the threshold, which independently establishes classification. Designation persistence after exposure changes remains unresolved.
No supplied text supports an existing-fund exemption, a classification grace period based on document updates, a home-regulator veto, or automatic designation based solely on a listed risk factor.

Footnote 1's separate 15% direct-investment limit does not replace the aggregate classification threshold or authorize direct investments up to 50%. UT Code 7.3 is missing for assessment of that separate limit; its dependency ID cannot be identified.

The separate LAF circular, Internal Product Approval Process circular and Advertising Guidelines are absent. They would be needed to assess their respective regimes in detail, but are not prerequisites to retaining the classification rule stated here. No supplied dependency mapping identifies them.
All supplied dependency source_hash values are null. None qualifies as AVAILABLE, and the anonymous IDs cannot reliably be assigned to named authorities.

No particular Fund, assessment date, holdings, NAV or designation record is supplied. Commencement and designation persistence also remain unresolved. These checks establish neither a fund-specific classification nor overall compliance.
